fixes.metadata: The prior QObject MetaCall gate intercepted an unrelated queued Library callback. A deterministic no-op callback reproduces the hosted assertion before the fix and remains a required delivered control. A UX-only existing PersistenceGate now holds MetadataService::read after actual I/O, scoped to the owned catalog and original path; real GUI events and final metadataChanged delivery remain required. Production builds contain no observer.
fixes.provider_pixels: Targeted native calibration differed in four RGB channels by one level with exact alpha. Reuse the existing GPU-eligible RGB <= 1 / exact CPU-alpha-geometry-format-colorspace-DPR oracle and its negative controls; no image-processing math changed.
fixes.scene_readback: Two retained PRV002 failures had one blue scene channel differing by two levels. The diagnostic captures byte-identical calibration/current provider images, also identical to the CPU reference; scene dimensions and alpha match. Treat Qt/Metal scaling/quantization as an inference. The scene-only comparison uses RGB <= 2 and exact alpha, with controls rejecting RGB 3, altered alpha, layout and geometry. Preview pixel limits remain separate and unchanged.
